findings.finding: Claim under doubt: The text != name fix (compute_fr_coherence) fully closes the description-exemption gap without missing any legitimate case. — TITLE_COLS ranks Name above Requirement/Text/Title, so a table with a Name column plus a Requirement/Text/Title column but no Description column would have the genuine descriptive column silently ignored (r.text reads Name), and the new filter would then deny an exemption that should hold. Checked every real fixture/corpus shape in this repo (golden.json, test_fr_table_reader_contract.py SHAPES, test_rtm_fr_table_shapes.py) and none combines Name with Requirement/Text/Title and no Description — so this is confirmed latent, not live.
